title: NSO Diagnostic
description: What the last nso-diagnostic-run scan found, and whether scans are still running. Evidence and causes are in the HTML report.

list.name: Scan finished
list.textFormat: A value pushed by a scan stays flat until the next scan replaces it.

list.name: instance
list.label: Agent
list.description: PROMETHEUS_INSTANCE of the agent to show. Each agent pushes its own numbers; this dashboard shows one agent at a time.

panels.title: ■ LAST SUCCESSFUL SCAN: AGE AND COVERAGE
Last good scan
panels.description: How long ago the last scan that produced a report finished. Green under 12 hours, orange from 12, red from 24. The panels below describe that scan. Latest scan attempt, above, says whether a newer attempt failed.

panels.title: Finished
panels.description: When the last good scan finished, in your browser's time zone.

panels.title: Took
panels.description: How long the last good scan took to run.

panels.title: Devices not covered
panels.description: Devices that were dropped or whose collection failed in the last scan.

panels.title: ■ SERVICES: FINAL STATUS FROM THE LAST SUCCESSFUL SCAN
OpUp
panels.description: PE-side checks passed. Customer traffic delivery is not tested.

panels.title: Unknown
panels.description: Not enough evidence. Unknown is not Down.

panels.title: Services not OpUp, by device, now
panels.description: A service counts under the device its failed check points to, else under every endpoint, so rows can overlap.

panels.title: Services not OpUp per device, over time
panels.description: Shows since when a device has had faulted services.

panels.title: Links gaining errors while up
panels.description: Links that are up but gained errors since the previous scan, as listed in the report. Solid lines: CRC errors per minute (left, log scale). Dashed lines: times the link went down or up (right). Each value is the average over the gap between two scans, so it shows the trend, not when the errors happened. A lead to follow up, not a service status. A link drops off once a scan finds it no longer gaining errors. The dashed lines mark 0.1 CRC errors a minute (orange, about 6 an hour) and 10 a minute (red). Any steady CRC on a link that is up is worth a look: a dirty connector, a marginal optic or fibre.

panels.title: ■ DEVICES AND ROUTING: THE LAST SUCCESSFUL SCAN
Device sync
panels.description: NSO can't reach: devices whose sync check failed (NSO cannot connect or the check errored); nothing read from them in this scan is confirmed. Locked: devices NSO shows as locked (southbound lock), usually someone's maintenance or a stuck session; nothing was read from them. Config drift: devices NSO reports out of sync, a change-management question; a locked device is not counted here.

panels.title: Physical down
panels.description: Physical links down across the fabric. Interfaces down across the fabric, including shut and unused ports, so the level is normal. Watch the line for a step up. One point per scan.

panels.title: IS-IS down
panels.description: IS-IS adjacencies down.

panels.title: BGP down
panels.description: BGP sessions down.

panels.title: ■ HARDWARE AND INFRASTRUCTURE: THE LAST SUCCESSFUL SCAN
Busiest CPU
panels.description: Busiest device by 5-minute CPU. The highest 5-minute CPU of any device when the last good scan read them, with the device's name. Red at 80% or more. Devices the scan could not read are not included: see Devices not covered. Shows no data until a scan has run on the newer image.

panels.title: Fullest memory
panels.description: Fullest device by memory use. The highest memory use of any device when the last good scan read them, with the device's name. Red at 85% or more. Devices the scan could not read are not included: see Devices not covered. Shows no data until a scan has run on the newer image.

panels.title: Hot sensors
panels.description: Devices with a hot sensor. Devices with a temperature sensor outside its limit when the last good scan read them. Devices the scan could not read are not counted: see Devices not covered.

panels.title: Fan faults
panels.description: Devices with a fan fault. Devices with a failed or degraded fan when the last good scan read them. Devices the scan could not read are not counted: see Devices not covered.

panels.title: Power faults
panels.description: Devices with a power fault. Devices with a failed or degraded power supply when the last good scan read them. Devices the scan could not read are not counted: see Devices not covered.

panels.title: LLM investigations
panels.description: How the scan's LLM work went, as in the report's Result line: Complete, Partial (some investigations did not reach a conclusion), Unavailable (no request succeeded), Skipped, or Halted (the provider's spend limit). Then how many investigations reached a conclusion. When the LLM was skipped, only Skipped is shown.

panels.title: Cost of last scan
panels.description: What the scan's LLM requests cost, as the provider reports it.

panels.title: LLM cost per scan
panels.description: What each scan's LLM requests cost.

panels.title: Budget left
panels.description: The provider's spend budget left this period, and its size. Orange below $100, red below $25.

panels.title: Model
panels.description: The model that made this scan's LLM findings.
